notes.title: The Tower of Wowers NEW Patch!
notes.content:
Hello!

Long time without updating the game but REJOICE --- we have put KEYBOARD config and CONTROLLER config in the game!!

Yay!!

HAVE FUN PLAYING and the game is currently on SALE!! Yay!


-Necro-

tags.feature: we have put KEYBOARD config and CONTROLLER config in the game!!

notes.title: Patch "Update 1" is now online!
notes.content:
Update 1 changes (notes)  [b]WARNING MAY CONTAIN PLOT SPOILERS[/b], best to read at own risk!: 


-ADD MORE TEXTS in battle --- to show SHITICAL attacks (crits), enemy HP and attacks and much more!
-Caught Spelling error at STAINED GLASS on Floor : The 90's.
-Floor 20 "I even lit that shit up myself" OLD FLAMEFACE (Fixed!). Showed the old old flame face - and he has changed since then!
-Ghost Made of Human Skulls random encounter changed from 15 to 20 steps. (Was spawning too often!)
-King Ssnak can now be able to poison you. Watch out! Those Anti Shit Potions will come in handy now!
-Added Metal King Ssnak being able to poison you.
-Bushman - Warrior!! Can equiped 2 AXES now.  Dual Weild!! 
-Added REVIVE ALL spell for DeezNuts that learns it hitting level 45
-The Bong of Creation --- Flavour text on a a certain Peaceful Spot (and worth double price now!)
-Flaming Bag of Shit doesn't get consumed when used!!! We FIXED that!
-Change MP cost on HEAL ALL  (was 1 MP). We believe it is fixed and now costs 30 MP
-Flame Face needed normal ATK buffed. Adjusted! 
-SOME Set of Dragon statues have additional flavour texts if party has beaten the tower (and holds elevator controller access).
-New Drop rates for Void ball and Death Shroud   ( 1 /75  ---  1 /50 ).
-New Plop errr... Drop rates on Blade of Ultimate Death 1 / 20,
-Mage spells buffed slightly.
-Fixed TOP OF THE TOWER typo (says enjoy recruiting these 2 characters when there is 3!)
-Bringer of the End spell for Mage added. (Mukwa earns at level 50) - Strongest Darkness spell!
-NEW BOSS : Flame Face *Shit Variant* ADDED on a few squares on the OUTSIDE of the map, complete with some new drops!! (can poison!)
-NEW BOSS : Tower of Pootrid Flesh *Shit Variant* ADDED on a few FLESH squares on floor 22. (can poison.)
-NEW RAID BOSS : The Shit Void and The Shit Darkness *Shit Variants* have been added to the "corners" of The Darkness, The Void raid. HOLY SHIT!
-Given the above we have ADDED the most POOwerful sword in the game for you collectibles (we're looking at you Elijah BlackMoon!! P.S - thank you for the feedback.)
